units.source_text: 女佣趁他们俩谈起山里的事，站起来就走了。

en.t: The maid took the chance when the two of them began talking about the mountains, stood up, and left.

units.source_text: 然而就连从这个村子也可以望见的几座山的名字，那女子也说不齐全。

en.t: Yet even the names of the mountains visible from this village were more than the woman could fully name.

units.source_text: 岛村提不起酒兴，女子却意外坦率地谈起自己也是生长在这个雪国，

en.t: Shimamura could not work up any appetite for drink, but the woman spoke with surprising frankness, saying that she too had grown up in this snow country,

units.source_text: 在东京的酒馆当女侍时被人赎身出来，本打算将来做个日本舞蹈师傅用以维持生计，

en.t: while working as a waitress in a Tokyo tavern she had been bought out, and had meant to support herself one day as a teacher of Japanese dance,

units.source_text: 可是刚刚过了一年半，她的恩主就与世长辞了。

en.t: but after barely a year and a half, her benefactor passed away.

units.source_text: 也许从那人死后到今天的这段经历，才是她的真正身世吧。

en.t: Perhaps what had happened to her from that man's death until today was her true story.

units.source_text: 这些她是不想马上坦白出来的。

en.t: Those were things she did not seem ready to confess at once.

units.source_text: 果真如此，这十九岁的人看起来倒像有二十一二岁了。

en.t: If that was true, this nineteen-year-old looked more like twenty-one or twenty-two.

units.source_text: 岛村这才得到一点宽慰，开始谈起歌舞伎之类的事来。

en.t: Only then did Shimamura feel a little at ease, and he began talking about kabuki and such things.

units.source_text: 她比他更了解演员的艺术风格和逸事。

en.t: She knew more than he did about actors' styles and anecdotes.

units.source_text: 也许她正渴望着有这样一个话伴吧，所以津津乐道。

en.t: Perhaps she had been longing for just such a companion in conversation, for she talked with eager delight.

units.source_text: 谈着谈着，露出了烟花巷出身的女人的坦率天性。

en.t: As she went on talking, she revealed the frank nature of a woman from the pleasure quarters.

units.source_text: 她似乎很能掌握男人的心理。

en.t: She seemed quite able to read a man's mind.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，岛村一开头就把她看作是良家闺秀。

en.t: Even so, from the start Shimamura had taken her for a young woman from a respectable family.

units.source_text: 加上他快一个星期没跟别人好好闲谈了，内心自然热情洋溢，首先对她流露出一种依恋之情。

en.t: Besides, after nearly a week without any real conversation with another person, warmth naturally welled up inside him, and he first felt a kind of attachment to her.

units.source_text: 他从山上带来的感伤，也浸染到了女子的身上。

en.t: The sentimentality he had brought down from the mountains seeped into the woman as well.
